actions: !searchForBlock type:oak_log search_range:128.
!collectBlocks type:oak_log num:7.
Craft 12 oak planks from the oak logs in your inventory.
Craft 1 crafting_table using 4 oak_planks from your inventory.
Use the crafting interface to combine the 4 oak_planks into 1 crafting_table.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 crafting_table.
Craft 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Repeat the crafting process to create 4 more sticks using 2 additional oak planks at the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains a total of 8 sticks.
Craft 2 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains a total of 9 sticks.
Use the crafting_table in your inventory.
Craft 1 wooden_pickaxe using 3 oak_planks and 2 sticks.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 wooden_pickaxe.
Find a stone block in the nearby area.
Use the wooden_pickaxe to mine the stone block.
Collect the cobblestone dropped from the mined stone block.
Repeat the process of mining stone and collecting cobblestone until you have 11 cobblestone in your inventory.
Place the crafting_table on the ground.
Open the crafting interface.
Use 3 cobblestones and 2 sticks in the crafting grid to craft 1 stone_pickaxe.
Take the stone_pickaxe from the crafting output.
Search for coal ore within a range of 128 blocks.
Go to the nearest coal ore block.
Mine the coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect the dropped coal until you have 3 coal in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal.
Open your crafting table interface.
Craft 1 furnace using 8 cobblestone.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 furnace.
Search for iron ore blocks in a nearby area within a range of 128 blocks.
Collect 7 raw iron by mining the iron ore blocks using the stone pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 raw iron.
Use the crafting table to create a furnace using the cobblestone in your inventory.
Place the furnace on the ground.
Use the furnace to smelt 1 raw_iron into 1 iron_ingot.
Add coal to the furnace as fuel.
Wait for the smelting process to complete.
Repeat the smelting process for 6 additional raw_iron to obtain a total of 7 iron_ingot.
Use the crafting_table to craft 3 iron_ingots from the raw_iron.
Use the crafting_table to craft 2 sticks from the oak_planks.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 iron_pickaxe using 3 iron_ingots and 2 sticks.
Craft 1 bucket using the crafting_table.
Use 3 iron_ingots from your inventory for crafting.
Place the bucket in your inventory after crafting.
Search for diamond ore within a range of 256 blocks.
Collect 29 diamond ore blocks using the iron pickaxe.
Search for gravel blocks within a radius of 64 blocks.
Collect 1 gravel block using the iron pickaxe.
Break the collected gravel block until it drops flint.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 flint.
Use the bucket from your inventory.
Search for a water source nearby.
Approach the water source.
Use the bucket on the water source to fill it with water.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 water_bucket.
Craft 1 diamond_pickaxe using the available resources in your inventory.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 3 diamonds in the crafting table grid.
Place 2 sticks in the crafting table grid.
Retrieve 1 diamond_pickaxe from the crafting table output.
Close the crafting table interface.
Craft 1 flint_and_steel using 1 iron_ingot and 1 flint.
Search for water within 256 blocks.
Use the water bucket on the nearest water source to fill it.
Search for lava within 256 blocks.
Use the water bucket on the nearest lava source to create obsidian.
Mine the newly created obsidian block with the diamond pickaxe.
Repeat the mining action until you have obtained 10 obsidian blocks.
Craft 1 diamond_boots using the crafting_table.
Collect 7 diamonds from your inventory.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_leggings.
Craft a diamond chestplate using the crafting table.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 8 diamonds in the crafting grid.
Confirm the crafting of the diamond chestplate.
Collect the diamond chestplate from the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_chestplate.
Use the crafting_table to craft the diamond_helmet using 5 diamonds.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_helmet.
Craft 1 diamond_sword using the crafting_table.
Use 2 diamonds from your inventory.
Use 1 stick from your inventory.
Use the flint_and_steel from your inventory to ignite the nether_portal structure.
Build the nether_portal using 10 obsidian blocks from your inventory.
Use the nether portal to enter the Nether.
Locate a blaze spawner in the Nether.
Approach the blaze spawner.
Attack and kill the nearest blaze until you obtain 1 blaze rod.
Craft 1 blaze_powder from 1 blaze_rod using the crafting_table.
Search for an enderman within a 128 block radius.
Approach the enderman carefully to avoid scaring it away.
Attack the enderman with the diamond sword until it is defeated.
Collect the ender pearl dropped by the enderman.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 ender_pearl.
Craft 1 ender_eye using 1 ender_pearl and 1 blaze_powder from your inventory.
